stem.text: Photochromic lenses in spectacles darken in sunlight because silver crystals are produced by the reaction shown.
Which statements are correct for this reaction?

items: Both silver and chlorine atoms have an oxidation number of zero.
The oxidation number of chlorine increases.
Electrons are transferred from $\text{Cl}^{-}$ ions to $\text{Ag}^{+}$ ions.
